paite: Hoihlou taka thupukna bawlt leh dikou taka gelhmite tung a gik hi!
english: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees;

paite: Meithaite a gallak bang ua, a om theihna ding uleh, pa neiloute a thil uh lak sak banga a bawl theihna ding un, neizouloute vaihawmna diktat tangsak lou ding leh, ka mite laka gentheite muh ding mawngmawng laksak tum.
english: to deprive the needy from justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their spoil, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!

paite: Huchiin, gawtna ni a hongtun chiang leh gamla pi-a a kipan huihpi a hongtun chiangin, bang na hih ding ua oi? panpihna ngen dingin kua kiang ah na taita ding ua leh? na thupina uh koiah na nuseta ding ua oi?
english: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?

paite: Hentate lakah a kun ding ua, thahte lakah a puk ding uh, hiaite lel a tan uh a hita ding hi. Huchi lawmlawma a hih inleng, a hehna lah a dai keia, a khut a lik lailai hi.
english: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

paite: Kisain Assuria mi, ka hehna khetbuk, ka lungkimlouhna chiang tawi!
english: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!

paite: Gallak la ding leh, thil lak sak la ding leh, kongzing buannawi banga ngap dingin amah jaw Pathian zahlou nam dou dingin ka sawl dinga, ka hehna mite sual dingin thu ka pe ding hi.
english: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me will I give him a command to take the spoil and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

paite: Himahleh aman huchibang a tup ahi keia, huchibang jaw a lungsimin leng a ngaihtuah sam kei; nam tam petmaha tam hihsiat leh hihmanthat ahi, lungsima a neih jawk.
english: However he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.

paite: Ka mi liante tengteng kumpipa ahi vek kei ua hia?
english: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?

paite: Kalno khua Karkemis khua bang hita lou ahi maw? Hamath khua Arpad khua bang hita lou ahi maw? Samari khua Damaska khua bang hita lou ahi maw?
english: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”

paite: Ka khutin milimte gam, Jerusalem khua leh Samari khua ate, sanga milim bawltawm hoih jaw neite leng, a zongkhe ta ngala.
english: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria;

paite: Samari leh a milimte tunga ka hihtak bangin Jerusalem leh a milimte tungah ka hih kei dia hia?
english: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

paite: Huchi a hih jiakin hichi ahi dinga; TOUPAN Zion tang leh Jerusalem kho sunga a nasep ding tengteng a sep khit hun chiangin Asuria kumpipa lungsim kiotsakna gah leh a mit kisathei thupina ka gawt sin hi.
english: Therefore it will happen that, when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his haughty looks.

paite: Aman, Ka khut hatnain ka hiht hi, ka pilna tohin; ka kizen ngala; chih chih gamgite khawng lah ka suana, a vaihawmna uh lah ka suta, laltutphaha tute lah mi hangsan hih bangin ka kai khia hi.
english: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I have understanding: and I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.

paite: Ka khutin chi chih hausaknate lah vasa bu bangin a zong khiaa; min vasa tuia pi loihsansa a la uh bangin lei tengteng ka la khinvekta hi; ka jap hiam, kam ka hiam ham hiamhim hiam leng a om kei uhi, a chi vial ngala.
english: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, have I gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”

paite: Heipiin thil ehna dinga a zangmi a kisaktheihsan dia hia? Singatnain a atmi a nuaisiah dia hia? Khetbukin a dommite a lik zosop diam aw, chiangin sing lah hi lou a lik zomah bang phet ahi.
english: Should an axe brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.

paite: Huaijiakin TOUPA, Sepaihte, TOUPAN, a mi thaute lakah gawnna a sawl dinga; a thupina nuaiah mei kuang lai lel bangin mei tohin a om ding.
english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.

paite: Huan, Israelte vakna mei a honghi dinga, a Mi Siangthou mah uleng meikuang ahi ding; huaiin ni khat thuin loulingneite leh khaulingneite a kangsakin a hihmangthang ding.
english: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.

paite: A gammang leh a lei hoih mun thupina leng, kha leh sa nasanin, a hihmang ding; huchiin, chiamtehna tawipen kia hun lai bang ahi ding.
english: He will consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.

paite: A gammanga sing om sek laite naupang gelh tham pheta tawm a hita ding.
english: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.

paite: Huan, huainiin hichi ahi dinga, Israelte omzek laite leh Jakob inkuanpihte laka a damlaiten amaute thatpa a muang nawnta kei ding ua; TOUPA Israelte Mi Singthou, chihtaktakin a muang zota ding uhi.
english: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

paite: A om zek lai. Jakob om zeklaite, Pathian hattak kiang ah a kik nawn ding uh.
english: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

paite: Na mi Israelte tuipi piaunel zahin om mah le uh, a om zek laite kia a kik nawn sin ngal ua; diktatna luan letna suksiatna lah tung dinga vaihawmpuk ahi.
english: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.

paite: TOUPA, Sepaihte TOUPAN, tawpna, tawpna tung ngei dinga vaihawmpuk lah, lei tengteng laizangah a bawl sin ngala.
english: For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, in the midst of all the earth.

paite: Huaijiakin, TOUPA, Sepaihte TOUPAN, hichiin a chi, Ziona om ka mite aw, Aigupta gama a hih bang un khetbuk a nou honvuain achiang na tunguah lik mah leh, Asuria mi jaw kihta kei un.
english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, says “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.

paite: Sawtlou chik nungin ka lungkimlouhna hongbei dia, ka hehna leng amaute hihmanthatna dia heiin a omta ding hi.
english: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”

paite: Ireb suangpia Midiante a thah lai bang un sepaihte tOUPAN amah sual dingin jepna a pei dinga; achiang lah tuipi tung lamah a om dinga Aigupta gama a pei bangin a pei ding hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.

paite: Huai niin hi chi ahi dinga, puakgik na liangjanga kipana lakmangin a om dinga, a hakkol leng na ngawngnga kipana lakmangin a om lai ding hi; thau nilh jiakin hakkol lah hihsiatin a omta dinga, chiin.
english: It will happen in that day, that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.

paite: Rimon akipan Aiath khua a tungta Migron khuaah a pai suakta; Mikmas khuaah a van a koihta.
english: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.

paite: Kuam ah a tumta uh; Geba khuaah a giakta uh; Ramah khuate a lingling ua; Saula, Gibeah khote a taimangta uhi.
english: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.

paite: Gallim kho tanu aw! na awin ngaihtakin kikou in; Laishah khua aw! ngaikhiain; Anathoth aw, hehpihhuai na lawmlawm chia!
english: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!

paite: Madmenah khote taimangin a omta uh; Gebim khuaa omte taimang tumin a kidelh luailuai uh.
english: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.

paite: tuni mahmahin Nob khuaah a tam sin; Zion tanu tang, Jerusalem mual pawng a khut a sin khum hi.
english: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

paite: Ngai dih, TOUPA, sepahte TOUPAN, thil mulkimhuaitakin ahiangte a sat khe dinga, sang pipite lah phuk in a om dinga, a dawk tuamte leng gawi niamin a om ding.Sikin gamnuai sing sahte a phuk dinga, LEbanon sidar singte mi thupi pukin a puk juajua ding uh.
english: Behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.

paite: Sikin gamnuai sing sahte a phuk dinga, LEbanon sidar singte mi thupi pukin a puk juajua ding uh.
english: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
